offices.name: Chief Marketing Officer
offices.purpose: Turn client knowledge into strong creative work, measurable campaigns and new business.
offices.boundary: Calvin approves creative direction, client deliverables, claims and outbound campaigns.

departments.name: Brand & Strategy
departments.purpose: Build the foundations every creative workflow reuses.

roles.name: Brand Strategist
roles.purpose: Define positioning, audiences and content pillars.
roles.output: Brand strategy and content pillars
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Brand Voice Agent
roles.purpose: Turn approved examples into usable writing rules.
roles.output: Tone-of-voice guide, examples and prohibited claims
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Competitor Research Agent
roles.purpose: Compare selected competitors using dated source evidence.
roles.output: Competitor audit and opportunities
roles.inputs: Client brief, selected competitor accounts and permitted source captures

departments.name: Creative Direction
departments.purpose: Translate strategy into a consistent visual language.

roles.name: Creative Director
roles.purpose: Set campaign art direction and review visual consistency.
roles.output: Creative brief, moodboard and visual rules
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Brand Guidelines Agent
roles.purpose: Document client palettes, typography and reusable layouts.
roles.output: Versioned brand guidelines and design tokens
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Grid & Calendar Planner
roles.purpose: Arrange a 15-post grid and turn approved ideas into production briefs.
roles.output: Grid plan, content mix and calendar draft
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

departments.name: Content Production
departments.purpose: Prepare assets and copy for owner-led production.

roles.name: Image Prompt Director

roles.output: Reference-indexed image prompt and accuracy checklist
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Caption & Copy Agent
roles.purpose: Write five distinct caption options using approved brand voice.
roles.output: Five caption options, hooks and calls to action
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Script & Storyboard Agent
roles.purpose: Plan natural scripts, shot sequences and editing notes.
roles.output: Reel scripts, shot lists and storyboards
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Creative Quality Agent

roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

departments.name: Publishing & Engagement
departments.purpose: Prepare and follow through on approved campaigns.

roles.name: Scheduling Agent
roles.purpose: Suggest times from available evidence and assemble approved posting batches.
roles.output: Scheduling proposal and publish receipts
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Email Campaign Agent
roles.purpose: Adapt approved campaign content into email drafts.
roles.output: Email sequence, subject lines and segment plan
roles.inputs: Approved campaign, audience consent records and email performance

roles.name: Community Response Agent
roles.purpose: Draft Instagram and WhatsApp responses from approved FAQs.
roles.output: Response drafts and escalation queue

departments.name: Growth & Insights
departments.purpose: Use evidence to retain clients and win suitable new work.

roles.name: Performance Analyst
roles.purpose: Explain supported metrics and identify useful next experiments.
roles.output: Client analytics report PPT and action plan
roles.inputs: Connected analytics or imported exports, reporting dates and approved KPI definitions

roles.name: Onboarding Audit Agent
roles.purpose: Identify brand, content, channel and asset gaps before work begins.
roles.output: Evidence-backed audit PPT and onboarding checklist
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

roles.name: Proposal Agent
roles.purpose: Turn discovery notes and approved scope into a tailored proposal.
roles.output: Proposal PPT and scope for owner review
roles.inputs: Discovery notes, service catalogue and CFO-reviewed pricing

roles.name: Content Repurposing Agent
roles.purpose: Adapt approved winners for another format while retaining brand voice.
roles.output: Reusable content library and format adaptations
roles.inputs: Approved client Brain, campaign brief and selected reference assets

offices.name: Chief Financial Officer
offices.purpose: Keep the agency financially clear, sustainable and properly scoped.
offices.boundary: Analysis and drafts only. Calvin authorises prices, payments, contracts and financial commitments.

roles.name: Bookkeeping Agent
roles.purpose: Match imported transactions and invoices without guessing missing values.
roles.output: Categorised ledger and reconciliation exceptions
roles.inputs: Imported transactions, invoices, receipts and currency/date context

roles.name: Billing Agent
roles.purpose: Prepare invoices and flag overdue balances from recorded terms.
roles.output: Invoice drafts and follow-up queue
roles.inputs: Approved client scope, invoice records and payment terms

roles.name: Receipt & Document Agent
roles.purpose: Extract receipt details and link them to financial records.
roles.output: Source-linked expense entries
roles.inputs: Uploaded receipts, supplier invoices and owner corrections

departments.name: Pricing & Profitability
departments.purpose: Know whether each client and package makes economic sense.

roles.name: Scope & Pricing Analyst
roles.purpose: Estimate effort and cost against approved service rates.
roles.output: Scope calculator and pricing recommendation
roles.inputs: Approved rate card, delivery requirements and estimated effort

roles.name: Client Profitability Analyst
roles.purpose: Compare client revenue with tracked delivery time and costs.
roles.output: Client margin view with explicit data gaps
roles.inputs: Recorded revenue, timesheets and attributable costs

roles.name: Cash-flow Planner
roles.purpose: Build scenarios from known balances and dated commitments.
roles.output: Cash-flow forecast with assumptions
roles.inputs: Balances, receivables, payables and recurring commitments

departments.name: Subscriptions & Spend
departments.purpose: Control tool costs and future model usage.

roles.name: Subscription Monitor
roles.purpose: Track subscriptions, renewal dates and owner-reported payment status.
roles.output: Renewal calendar and duplicate-tool review
roles.inputs: Subscription records, invoices and owner payment confirmations

roles.name: AI Cost Analyst
roles.purpose: Compare actual cost per useful output and local versus API options.
roles.output: Cost and quality comparison
roles.inputs: Usage logs, local compute measurements and verified provider prices

offices.name: Chief Technology Officer
offices.purpose: Build reliable software, trusted data and reusable automation for the agency.
offices.boundary: Deployments, access changes and external mutations remain explicit owner decisions.

roles.name: QA & Accessibility Agent
